test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Emperor _____ awarded the title Zarin Qalam or Golden Pen to Muhammad Hussein al-Qatib Kashmiri for his beautiful handwriting.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Akbar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Akbar was** born on October 15, 1542**, in **Umarko**t (now in** Sindh Province, Pakistan**).
 
• Akbar was the** son of Humayun** and the grandson of Babur.
 
• Akbar got enthroned at a very early **stage of 14 years.**
 
• Akbar ruled from** 1556 to 1605**.
 
• Akbar got the title of ‘**Shahenshah**’ because of his kindness, fearlessness, and bravery.
 
• Akbar started a system called** Mansabdari **to organize his military.
 
• **Illahabad, Allahabad (now Prayagraj**) was named by Akbar.
 
• The most notable wife of Akbar was **Jodha Bai,** Princess of Jaipur.
 
• Important battle of Akbar
 
 
• **Battle of Thanesar (9 April 1567).**
 
• **The second battle of Panipat (5 November 1556).**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Muhammad Husain al-Katib (Zarrin Qalam), is one of the most celebrated** calligraphers **of Emperor Akbar’s time.
 
• Muhammad Husayn al-Katib** (active India, ca. 1560–1620).​**
